title: NFT DAO Tracker
tagline: NFT DAO Tracker is an DAO AD delivery tool for Web3.0 users, including individuals, DAOs and other crypto teams.The dapp was inspired by the ideas and creations of projects like IPFS, Superfluid  and Polygon.
description:
It is a promotional tool  for DAO that helps project  Project Director to  airdrop  their NFTs and find your potential  DAO members  in a new way based on blockchain technology. 



We aim to unlock the easy way in metaverse for whom want to build a DAO at startup through free NFT with $matic
how_its_made: We use IPFS to store NFT's Info, we use superfluid to separate shares between people who received NFT ads and have done tasks, and we make it on Polygon Testnet. We use React.js to finish UI part, mysql to store users' task info. When people do their task, they'll get award by superfluid and earn some matic.
